l.i: Ecce, hic est, aut illic Christus: ne erretis, quoniam in caelis est ad
dexteram Dei Patris. Ad extremum sublata voce, Pater, inquit, caele-
stis in manus tuas commendo Spiritum meum, teque oro vt pro gra-
tia tua, puerulos meos in timore nominis tui coferues. His dictis pri-
mum laqueo suffocatus, flammisque adustus, deinde in patibulo ex-
tra vrbem suspensus inter fures & latrones fuit: sed haud dubie ani-
ma ipsius in caelum sublata est, propter Saluatorem nostrum Iesum Chri-
stum, qui corpus etiam eiusdem in vltimo die excitabit, vt beata im-
mortalitate cum omnibus Sanctis fruatur.

page.notes: Red underlining runs through several lines of the text (about "Ecce, hic est" to "Geneuam"), with a few hand marks. This is handwriting or marking, not print, so it is left out. The fragments at the far left edge (e.g. "E.", "ne", "te") are the edge of the neighbouring page and are left out. The woodcut initial at the start of the ANNO paragraph is read as "A" with [?]. "Leuelhæus" is doubtful ([?]). "anabo" and "ij profectò sumus" are doubtful as printed. "Perginus" is probably a printing error for "Pergimus" but is copied as printed. The line "Illo deducti," ends the page; the signature "Nn. iij." sits below it at the right.
